吧.gloss: a sentence-final particle used for suggestions, requests or uncertainty

还.gloss: still; yet; also; to return something

只.gloss: only; just; a classifier for certain animals and objects

头.gloss: head; the leading part or beginning of something

分.gloss: to divide; a minute; a unit of money

把.gloss: to hold; used before an object to mark how it is handled

得.gloss: to obtain; must; used to introduce a complement

着.gloss: used after a verb to mark an ongoing action or state

啦.gloss: a sentence-final particle expressing a change or emphasis

地.gloss: ground; earth; used before a verb to mark an adverbial modifier

嘛.gloss: a sentence-final particle used to state something obvious or explain a reason

干嘛.gloss: why; what for; to do what

行.gloss: to walk; to go; to be acceptable

於.gloss: in; at; to (a traditional form of 于)

阿.gloss: a prefix used before a name or kinship term to show familiarity

道.gloss: way; road; a classifier for dishes and other items

令.gloss: to order; an order; to cause

发.gloss: to send; to issue; to develop

位.gloss: position; place; a polite classifier for people

场.gloss: a place used for an activity; a classifier for events

背.gloss: back (part of the body); to carry on the back

局.gloss: a bureau or office; a game or round; a situation

系.gloss: system; department; to tie or fasten

台.gloss: a platform; a desk or table; a classifier for machines
